Damage windows created

The relic responds to the wearer's sins, but none of them serves as a gift. It eagerly empowers one who is higher, angrier, hungrier, richer, or more patient than their victim, but leaves a crack in every advantage. Once circumstances change, the same sin begins to work against the owner.
Attempts to remove the ring
relics.description.ring_of_thrift.abilit: Reduces the relic bearer's mana cost by %1$s%%.
+1 experience point for each spell cast that maintained accelerated mana regeneration.
+1 experience point for each spell cast without consuming mana.
+1 experience point for each point of mana returned by delayed refund.
Each consecutive spell cast increases the relic bearer's mana regeneration speed by %5$s%% for %4$s seconds per trigger. The effect stacks up to %6$s times.
%2$s%% of spent mana is returned after %3$s seconds.
When casting a spell, has a %7$s%% chance to consume no mana.
relics.description.ring_of_thrift.descri: The relic bearer's arcane flow becomes steadier, losing less power with each cast spell. Part of the spent mana does not disperse without a trace, but lingers in the conductive circuit, waiting to return a few moments later.
While running continuously, gradually increases the player's movement speed, reaching the maximum bonus of %1$s%% after 5 seconds. As movement speed increases, block slipperiness also increases.
+1 experience point for every 10 sparks created
+1 experience point for each point of damage reduced through skating
+1 experience point for each second of skating
+1 experience point for each target hit by a spark
As movement speed increases, resistance to incoming damage also increases, up to %3$s%%.
While drifting, scatters sparks that deal %4$s damage and set targets on fire for %5$s seconds per unit of the relic wearer's speed at the moment they appear.
Increases step height while running by %2$s blocks.
relics.description.roller_skate.descript: With this relic, ordinary running quickly stops being ordinary. The surface slides underfoot, movement becomes sharper, and on a hard drift, sparks fly from under the wheels, cutting no worse than a sword.
relics.description.shield_of_retaliation: Holding RMB opens a parry window for %1$s seconds. Incoming damage is blocked if its source is in front of the player; damage without a source position is blocked regardless of view direction. If the shield parries nothing during the window, the next attack against the player within %3$s seconds deals %2$s% more damage. After RMB is released, a successful parry, or the window ends, the shield goes on cooldown for %4$s seconds.
+a random amount of experience up to the blocked damage
The shield blocks damage throughout the entire parry window, not just the first successful hit.

While the shield is active, projectiles flying into it freeze in front of the player and follow their gaze. Each caught projectile extends the parry window by %6$s seconds. When RMB is released or the window ends, all caught projectiles are fired from their current positions toward the target under the crosshair, dealing %5$s% more damage.
On successfully blocking damage, all targets within %7$s blocks in front of the player are stunned for %8$s seconds.
The shield demands not strength, but a flawless choice of moment. A blow met at the right instant dies before the relic's bearer, leaving the enemy with nothing.
relics.description.sphere_of_self_sacrif: On use, consumes 33% of the player's maximum health, restoring twice that amount over the next 10 seconds. Up to %1$s health restoration effects can exist simultaneously. Reusing the ability resets the duration of all active health restoration effects.
+1 experience for each point of damage reduced by health restoration effects
+1 experience for each point of damage nullified in exchange for triggering the ability
+1 experience for each activation of the ability
Reduces incoming damage by %2$s%% for each active health restoration effect.

If the number of health restoration effects has not reached the maximum and incoming damage exceeds the damage dealt by the ability, the damage is reduced to the ability's damage value, and the current number of health restoration effects is increased by 1.

While crouching, right-clicking nullifies all active health restoration effects, releasing them as homing blood projectiles at the target in front of you. Each projectile deals damage equal to the remaining amount of health its corresponding effect had yet to restore.
Damage mitigated by health restoration effects
Health restored by health restoration effects
Damage mitigated in exchange for ability activation
Damage mitigation triggers in exchange for ability activation
The relic takes health away just as willingly as it later returns it. The wearer opens access to their own blood, and what was lost slowly returns with interest.
If damage taken by the relic bearer exceeds %1$s%% of their maximum health, has a %2$s%% chance to release up to %3$s spikes in different directions. Each spike deals %4$s damage and applies Slowness III for 5 seconds.
+1 experience point for each spike burst trigger.
+1 experience point for each additional spike trigger.
+1 experience point for each spike hit.
A spike hit applies bleeding level %5$s to the target for %6$s seconds.
Triggering the ability reduces incoming damage to the relic bearer by %7$s%% for %8$s seconds.
A spike hit has a %9$s%% chance to release up to %10$s additional spikes.
relics.description.spiked_cloak.descript: A heavy blow awakens living spikes within the relic's fabric, sending them flying from the bearer in every direction. Each released shard digs into a target, wounding it and hindering its movement.
A crouch jump propels the relic wearer in the opposite direction of their gaze with %1$s%% force. Subsequent landings until coming to a full stop will bounce the relic wearer off horizontal surfaces, completely negating fall damage. To forcefully stop the ability's effect, simply hold the jump or crouch key before landing.
+1 experience point for each bounce performed
+1 experience point per radius unit of each created shockwave
+1 experience point for each target hit by a shockwave
+1 experience point for each additional point of damage dealt during jumps or bounces
Using the ability grants full invisibility until the next landing.

Crouching during landing creates a shockwave with a radius of %3$s blocks, dealing %4$s damage and stunning for %5$s seconds. Each shockwave parameter depends on the relic wearer's vertical speed at the moment of landing.
Increases damage dealt by %2$s%% for each bounce off surfaces during a single use of the ability.
Additional Damage Dealt in Jumps and Bounces
Time Spent in Jumps and Bounces
relics.description.springy_boot.descript: With this relic, a fall rarely ends with the first touch of the ground. The surface pushes the wearer back into the air, and the movement continues from bounce to bounce until it runs out on its own.
relics.description.staff_of_the_spectral: When activated, puts the bearer into a spectral state and propels them forward in the direction they are looking, allowing them to pass freely through blocks. During movement, nearby blocks are temporarily replaced with a spectral form that does not obstruct travel. The ability consumes one charge for each second of active movement and ends when charges are depleted or movement stops. The staff stores up to %1$s charges and restores one charge every %3$s seconds.
+1 experience point for each second in spectral form.
While the ability is active, the bearer gains the Immortality effect.
If the ability ends in a location where the bearer cannot safely stand, they are automatically returned to the last safe position.
While the ability is active, all entities within %2$s blocks become visible through obstacles.

The relic bearer briefly slips from the world's familiar layer, leaving the body as only an unsteady ghost of form. Whether stone, wood, or metal, an obstacle loses its density and lets the bearer pass through like a shadow through smoke.
relics.description.whirling_broom.abilit: When used, summons a broom and automatically seats the relic bearer on it. The broom moves at a speed of %1$s, cannot rise higher than %2$s blocks above the ground, has %3$s health, recovers %4$s seconds after being destroyed, and regenerates 1 health once every %5$s seconds.
While the relic bearer is riding the broom, incoming damage to them is reduced by %6$s%%.
While the relic bearer is riding the broom, any projectiles pass through them.
Holding the sprint key accelerates the broom by %7$s%% and consumes %8$s mana per second.
relics.description.whirling_broom.descri: The air beneath the broom's bristles condenses into a stable support, allowing the relic bearer to maneuver freely above the ground and stay airborne. Its height is limited, but sufficient to glide confidently over the surface, bypass obstacles, and maintain control.
relics.description.whirling_broom.synerg: The synergy is deactivated and provides no bonuses.
While flying on the broom, leaves a chain of lightning behind the relic bearer that lasts %9$s seconds and deals %10$s damage on contact.
relics.description.whirlisprig_petals.ab: Has up to %1$s charges, restoring each charge in %2$s seconds. Pressing RMB consumes 1 charge and launches the relic bearer %3$s blocks upward.
+1 experience point for each attack empowered by accumulated charges.
+1 experience point for each second of active lift.
+1 experience point for each directed use of the petals.
Each repeated use of the ability before landing accumulates 1 charge. Each charge increases the damage of the next attack by %4$s%%. All charges are reset on attack or landing.
Using the ability launches the relic bearer in the direction they are looking instead of the usual upward lift.
When the relic is held in hand, fully suppresses fall damage and grants the relic bearer's movements additional inertia.
relics.description.whirlisprig_petals.de: A light vortex of petals catches the relic bearer's movements, helping them sharply lift off the ground and maintain balance in the air.
relics.description.wing_of_the_wild_stal: Allows flight like with elytra for no more than %1$s seconds, after which the relic bearer is forced into descent.
+1 experience point for each point of damage reduced while flying.
+1 experience point for each dash while flying.
+1 experience point for each attack performed while flying.
+1 experience point for each second of flight.
Double-pressing the jump key while flying performs a swift dash forward with a force of %4$s. The ability cooldown is %5$s seconds.
Reduces incoming damage to the relic bearer while flying by %2$s%%.
Attacks performed by the relic bearer while flying deal %3$s%% more damage.
The air catches the relic bearer and lets them fly briefly like with elytra. The flight quickly turns into descent, but gives enough time to reposition, escape pursuit, or strike a target from above.
The synergy is deactivated and provides no bonuses.
While flying with the wing, leaves a chain of lightning behind the relic bearer that lasts %1$s seconds and deals %2$s damage on contact.

starbunclemania.balloon.tooltip: Changes a starbuncle's job to transport Mekanism chemical around. Can be dyed and used as a simple cosmetic by sneaking while using it, without changing its current behavior. Supported familiars: Starbuncle, Drygmy, Wixie.
starbunclemania.battery.tooltip: Changes a starbuncle's job to transport FE energy around. Can be used as a simple cosmetic by sneaking while using it, without changing its current behavior.
starbunclemania.bucket.tooltip: Changes a starbuncle's job to transport fluids around. Can be used as a simple cosmetic by sneaking while using it, without changing its current behavior.
starbunclemania.builder_hat.tooltip: Changes a starbuncle's job to place blocks in specified spots. Can be used as a simple cosmetic by sneaking while using it, without changing its current behavior.
starbunclemania.chef_hat.tooltip: Cosmetic curio for Players, Starbuncles and Wixie Familiars.
starbunclemania.degree_hat.tooltip: Cosmetic for your familiars. Supported creatures: Starbuncles, Bookwyrm (Familiar). Also allows item starbuncles to read Direction Scrolls.
starbunclemania.glyph_desc.glyph_pickup_: Pickups Fluids from world and fill a tank in the hotbar or next to the turret
starbunclemania.glyph_desc.glyph_place_f: Place Fluid in world, draining from a tank in the hotbar or next to the turret
starbunclemania.miner_hat.tooltip: Changes a starbuncle's job to mine blocks in specified spots. You can give it a tool to use, defaults to an iron pick. Can be used as a simple cosmetic by sneaking while using it, without changing its current behavior.
starbunclemania.page.direction_scroll: Provides a face/direction to Starbuncle automations. When the scroll is used on a starbuncle or placed in an item frame on a block, the starbuncle will interact with the block from the specified face.
starbunclemania.page.fluid_jar: A tank made from cascading archwood logs that can hold up to 16 buckets of fluid. If used to store a potion fluid and a potion jar is placed above it, the fluid will be converted to the jar for flask/melding use.
starbunclemania.page.fluid_scroll: Provides a filter to Starbuncle fluid automations. Works like the item counterpart, used on a starbuncle or placed in an item frame on the tank.
starbunclemania.page.fluid_sourcelink: Consumes fluids to generate source. Will automatically drain from tanks below it if compatible.
starbunclemania.page.player_cosmetic: Have you ever wanted to look a bit more like a Starbuncle? Or have a cool sandy hat, horns or even a propeller? Now you can! These accessories are purely cosmetic and can be worn by players in the Head curio slot.
starbunclemania.page.robin_mask: Allows Starbuncles to round-robin items between inventories. While wearing the accessory, the Starbuncle will only pickup items from the ground. Each stacked starbuncle will carry maxStack/numDestInventories items, before moving to the next inventory.
starbunclemania.page.source_condenser: Condense the Source from Jars into a stable fluid. Will automatically output to tanks below it if possible.
starbunclemania.page.star_balloon: Allows Starbuncles to transport simple gasses [Mekanism]. Can be dyed if used as cosmetic, but will use the stored gas color when used for transport. Once wearing the accessory, use the Dominion wand to connect them between gas tanks.
starbunclemania.page.star_battery: Allows Starbuncles to transport energy. Once wearing the accessory, use the Dominion wand to connect them between FE blocks.
starbunclemania.page.star_bin: Allows Starbuncles to embrace their inner raccoon and trash items. While wearing the accessory the Starbuncle will void any nearby item on the ground.
starbunclemania.page.star_bucket: Allows Starbuncles to transport fluids. Once wearing the accessory, use the Dominion wand to connect them between tanks.
starbunclemania.page.star_hat: Accessories from StarbuncleMania aren't just for the worker starbuncles to enjoy, you can use them on your starbuncle familiar too! This one doesn't do anything, but is surely stylish. Shift-clicking a starby with an accessory will only set it as cosmetic, without setting the job.
starbunclemania.page.star_saddle: Allows Starbuncles to transport players. While wearing the accessory, the Starbuncle becomes big enough to be rideable. [Still a bit wip, might be a bit wonky]
starbunclemania.page.wixie_cook: The Wixie can now cook! Place a Wixie on a furnace to allow it to smelt and smoke items, also compatible with a cooking pot [Farmers Delight] and crucibles [EidolonRepraised] to automate them.
starbunclemania.page.wixie_cut: Place a Wixie charm on a stonecutter or on a cutting board to have it use their cutting recipes for craftings.
starbunclemania.page.wixie_mixer: Place a Wixie charm on a fluid jar to convert it to a different type of cauldron. The Mixer has two internal tanks, for water and milk, to avoid using buckets in recipes. Only works for crafting table recipes, will always consume only one unit of the fluid needed.
starbunclemania.page.wyrm_degree: Allows Starbuncles to insert/extract items from a specific side with Direction Scrolls.
starbunclemania.robin_mask.tooltip: Tweaks the starbuncle's item transport to round-robin items between inventories, also stops pickup. Can be used as a simple cosmetic by sneaking while using it, without changing its current behavior.
starbunclemania.simple_cosmetic.tooltip: Simple cosmetic for your familiars. Supported familiars: Starbuncle, Wixie, Drygmy, Bookwyrm.
starbunclemania.trash_bin.tooltip: Changes a starbuncle's job to void the items it pickups and from linked chests. Can be used as a simple cosmetic by sneaking while using it, without changing its current behavior.
starbunclemania.wixie_cauldron.cooking_p: Use a Wixie Charm on a Cooking Pot. With this, Wixies will use cooking pot recipes
Use a Wixie Charm on a Crucible. With this, Wixies will use Eidolon's crucible recipes
starbunclemania.wixie_cauldron.cutting_b: Use a Wixie Charm on a Cutting Board. With this, Wixies will use cutting board recipes
starbunclemania.wixie_cauldron.mixer.too: Use a Wixie Charm on a Fluid Jar. With this, Wixies will use the milk and water in the side tanks for crafting recipes instead of buckets.
Use a Wixie Charm on a Furnace. With this, Wixies will use smelt and smoke recipes.

telemetry.event.game_load_times.descript: This event can help us figure out where startup performance improvements are needed by measuring the execution times of the startup phases.
telemetry.event.game_load_times.title: Game Load Times
telemetry.event.performance_metrics.desc:
Knowing the overall performance profile of Minecraft helps us tune and optimize the game for a wide range of machine specifications and operating systems. 
Game version is included to help us compare the performance profile for new versions of Minecraft.
telemetry.event.world_load_times.descrip: It’s important for us to understand how long it takes to join a world, and how that changes over time. For example, when we add new features or do larger technical changes, we need to see what impact that had on load times.
telemetry.event.world_load_times.title: World Load Times
telemetry.event.world_loaded.description:
Knowing how players play Minecraft (such as Game Mode, client or server modded, and game version) allows us to focus game updates to improve the areas that players care about most.
The World Loaded event is paired with the World Unloaded event to calculate how long the play session has lasted.
telemetry.event.world_loaded.title: World Loaded
telemetry.event.world_unloaded.descripti:
This event is paired with the World Loaded event to calculate how long the world session has lasted.
The duration (in seconds and ticks) is measured when a world session has ended (quitting to title, disconnecting from a server).

toomanyglyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_chaining: Causes a spell to chain through multiple grouped targets, either similar blocks or living entities other than the caster. AOE increases target count. Pierce increases maximum jump distance between targets.
toomanyglyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_filter_an: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets an Animal
toomanyglyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_filter_bl: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets a Block
toomanyglyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_filter_en: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets an Entity
toomanyglyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_filter_is: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets a baby
Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets an adult
toomanyglyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_filter_it: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets an Entity
toomanyglyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_filter_li: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets a Living Entity
Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets a Living Entity but not a Monster
Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets a Living Entity but not a Player
toomanyglyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_filter_mo: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets a Living Entity
toomanyglyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_filter_pl: Stops the spell from resolving unless it targets a Living Entity
toomanyglyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_ray: Instantaneously strikes the pointed-at target, at limited yet greater range than Touch. Mana is expended whether or not the ray hits anything. AOE increases range. Sensitive 1 lets the ray strike objects that do not block motion, such as plants or floating Magelight globes. Sensitive 2 allows the ray to strike fluids.
toomanyglyphs.glyph_desc.glyph_reverse_d: Reverses the direction of the spell, making it resolve as it was cast from the opposite side of the block. Especially useful with block-placing spells, as reversing the direction of pierce will point towards the caster instead of away.
